name: Fill PDF forms from JSON data with JustFill and an n8n form trigger
description:
## Quick overview
Collect an existing PDF and JSON through an n8n form, upload the binary, map named fields, fill the original layout, and return a temporary download link. For new runs, use the strict-mapping JSON linked in Setup; the catalog JSON is an older version.

## How it works
1. Triggers when a user submits an n8n form with a PDF upload and a “Data JSON” text payload.
2. Calls the JustFill MCP API to request a one-time upload slot, then uploads the submitted PDF to the provided URL.
3. Calls JustFill to open the uploaded PDF and retrieve its saved template field metadata.
4. Parses the submitted JSON and matches its keys to JustFill template field names (case- and punctuation-insensitive), producing a field-ID-to-value map.
5. Sends the mapped values to JustFill to fill the PDF and returns a temporary download URL for the generated file.
6. Redirects the form response to the filled PDF download link.

## Setup
1. Start with the [setup guide and synthetic test PDF](https://justfill.app/integrations/n8n-fill-pdf-forms?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=b2b_pdf_automation_2026q3&utm_content=deterministic_template). Import the [current strict-mapping workflow JSON](https://github.com/mrmaciej1/justfill-mcp/blob/main/examples/n8n/fill-pdf-workflow.json) from the public repository. Create a JustFill account and API key; use the Config placeholder only for local tests and an n8n credential or environment variable in production.
2. Save a JustFill template for each PDF you plan to fill (with named fields) so the workflow can map JSON keys to those field names.
3. Use the form trigger URL in n8n with a synthetic PDF and a minimal JSON object. In the current repository version, names match exactly after case and punctuation normalization with Unicode letters preserved. Unknown keys, ambiguous names, and duplicate field targets stop before filling; arrays and nested values are rejected. Test every mapping before connecting a real data source.

## Requirements
- JustFill account and API key
- A reviewed JustFill template with named fields for the exact PDF version
- An n8n instance with Form Trigger, HTTP Request, and Code nodes

## Customization
- Replace the Form Trigger with Gmail, Google Drive, Dropbox, Airtable, or a webhook.
- Move the JustFill API key from the Config node to an n8n credential or environment variable before production.
- Extend the mapping node with aliases when source JSON keys differ from template field names.

## Additional info
JustFill is built by the template author. No AI model key is required after the PDF template is reviewed and saved. Free downloads may contain a watermark; paid downloads can be clean. Links are temporary. Never publish real API keys or customer data. The repository JSON has stricter validation than this older catalog copy; use the linked current version for new runs.

parameters.content:
### Before you run this workflow

Follow the guided setup and synthetic supplier-intake example:
https://justfill.app/integrations/n8n-fill-pdf-forms?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=b2b_pdf_automation_2026q3&utm_content=deterministic_template

Create a JustFill API key at https://justfill.app/account and replace the placeholder in **Config**. Open the exact recurring PDF once with a JustFill MCP client, review and name its fields, then save the template; every later run maps JSON deterministically without an AI model.

### 1. Collect the document and values

The form accepts the recurring PDF plus a JSON object. Each JSON key should match a reviewed template field name, for example `company_name` or `invoice_number`.

### 2. Upload the PDF safely

JustFill creates a one-time upload URL, and n8n sends the file as binary multipart data. The workflow never embeds the PDF as base64 inside a JSON-RPC request.

### 3. Reuse reviewed field names

JustFill reuses the saved layout for this PDF. The Code node matches JSON keys to named fields without case or punctuation differences and reports any unmatched keys.

### 4. Fill and return the original PDF

JustFill writes the mapped values into the existing layout and returns a temporary download URL. The final form response redirects the user to that generated PDF.

parameters.formDescription: Upload a PDF that has a saved JustFill template and provide the values as JSON.

nodes.name: Prepare upload
nodes.notes: Parses the MCP upload-slot response and preserves the submitted PDF as binary for the one-time upload.

nodes.name: Map values to fields
nodes.notes: Maps submitted JSON keys to the stable field IDs from the previously reviewed JustFill template.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.notes: Shapes the JustFill response into the temporary download contract used by the final redirect node.
